lang.label: Interface language
lang.hint: Applies to menus, settings and messages. Names, titles and notes you entered stay as they are — they are not translated.
lang.regionHint: Applies language, date, time and number defaults. Tweak the fields below if needed.
lang.dateHint: Used in history, audit export and inventories. Default is YY/MM/DD.
lang.timeHint: Clock on timestamps in history and exports.
lang.timezoneHint: Instance timestamps follow this zone. Browser uses each device’s zone.
lang.numberHint: Thousands and decimal separators for counters, stats and exports.

account.resetPrefsConfirm: Reset preferences? Favorites, open-on-load, collapsed categories and theme are stored in this browser’s local storage and will be cleared. Portal content is not changed.

empty.categoryLead: Group your links, sites and notes into categories.

settings.subtitle: Subtitle
settings.brandClick: Click a thumbnail to import. A logo also copies the favicon.

settings.resetConfirm: Reset the whole portal? Spaces, cards, themes, tags, statistics and accounts are replaced. Admin access becomes admin / admin again.

item.generalLeadApp: Title, icon, description, category and tags.
item.linkLead: Main link, opening, extra links and reachability check.
item.sizeLead: How much grid space the card takes.
item.name: Name
item.primaryLinkHint: Opened when the card is clicked.
item.urlDupOnCard: This URL is already used on this card.
item.urlNeedScheme: Must include a scheme, e.g. https://host or ssh://host

item.embedBorderHint: Shows a fine frame around the embedded page.
item.embedBgHint: None keeps the page transparent. Default uses the theme’s neutral background. Custom sets a color of your choice.
item.sameWindowHint: Opens the link in the current window. When unchecked, opens in a new tab (_blank).
item.embedLead: Show a page inside the portal
item.probeHubHint: Reachability is disabled in hub mode.
item.probeFirstLinkHint: Only checks the first link of the card.

space.generalLead: Name, icon and display in the bar.
space.permLead: Who can view and edit this space.
space.seeHint: By default everyone can see this space, including when signed out. The admin always sees everything.
space.noAccounts: No account to allow — Create accounts in Access.
space.editHint: Can edit cards and categories in this space.
space.hideLabelHint: The space shows as an icon only in the navigation bar.
space.xferHint: Export this space, or import a file as a new space. The current space is not replaced.

category.permLead: Who can view and edit this category.
category.seeHint: By default, whoever can see the space can see this category. The admin always sees everything.
category.editHint: Can edit cards in this category.

backup.importHint: Import overwrites spaces, cards, themes, tags, statistics, accounts and the journal
backup.inventoryHint: List of cards (space, type, URL) for an audit or a spreadsheet

toast.needSpaceForCard: Switch to a space to add a card
toast.noEditSpace: No permission to edit this space

seed.cardDesc: Replace this example with a real card.

info.statsHint: The icon opens the top 10 most clicked cards. The day is always shown in the bar. The week appears after more than one day of history, the month after a week, the year after a month.
info.statsHintHidden: The information bar is hidden in Presentation.
info.legendHint: The icon opens the legend for card icons (link hub, extra links, probe, favorite, tags).
info.resetHint: Clears every card click counter. The information bar and the top 10 start again from zero.
info.probeResetHint: Sets every card with a probe (HTTP or ICMP) to None.

banner.dev: Development mode (npm run dev) — Do not expose as-is
banner.weakPassword: Administrator password is too weak. Change it in Settings → Access.
banner.noPassword: Passwordless admin sign-in is on (Settings → Security).

probe.tlsUnverified: HTTPS certificate could not be verified
probe.icmpUnavailable: ICMP unavailable here (no ping). Resolved host: {host}

cat.resetLayoutConfirm: Reset every card in this category to 1×1? Order is unchanged.

oidc.issuerHint: Realm URL, without /.well-known/… Behind a proxy: PORTAL_PUBLIC_ORIGIN and PORTAL_TRUST_PROXY=1.
oidc.secretHint: Leave empty for a public client (PKCE). Confidential: paste the secret.
oidc.autoCreate: Create a viewer account if it does not exist
oidc.redirect: Redirect URI to register with the issuer:

ldap.bindHint: Optional service account. Empty: bind as user@domain or DOMAIN\user.
ldap.domainHint: Shown on the sign-in form next to Local. Local login always remains.
ldap.autoCreate: Create a viewer account if it does not exist

pres.clickCountHint: Shows how many clicks each card received.
pres.catCountsHint: Shows how many cards sit in each category heading.
pres.favEmbedsHint: Lets people star embedded-page cards. Off by default.
pres.favNotesHint: Lets people star note cards. Off by default.
pres.onlineIconsHint: Offline by default. Turn on only if the portal has Internet access — a click copies the icon locally.
pres.navRichIcons: Local and online icons on spaces and categories
pres.navRichIconsHint: Spaces and categories can use imported or Iconify icons, not only Lucide symbols.
pres.annexFade: Fade the background of extra-link menus
pres.annexFadeHint: Dims the portal behind the extra-links menu on a card.
pres.ctxHideUrlHint: Shows only the link name and the copy button in extra-links and right-click menus.
pres.showInfoBarHint: Bottom bar with clicks, down probes and statistics. Details are in the Information section.
pres.cardResize: Resize cards by dragging their edges
pres.cardResizeHint: Drag a card edge to change its width and height on the grid.
pres.cardContextMenuHint: Opens extra links and copies the link with a right-click. Extra links are set on the card.
pres.cardDragCollapse: Collapse other categories while moving a card
pres.cardDragCollapseHint: While you drag a card, other categories collapse. Hover a heading to expand it. Drop on a heading to move the card there.
pres.cardIconBgHint: Shows a colored square behind card icons. Off: icons sit directly on the card.

reach.blinkHint: The down-probe count in the information bar pulses when at least one probe is down.
reach.infoHidden: The information bar is hidden in Presentation — the down alert is not shown.
reach.perCard: Per-card control is set in Link → Reachability check.

sec.tlsHint: Targets with a self-signed certificate show as down.
sec.authOnlyHint: Visitors no longer see a reachability dot on cards.
sec.httpOnlyHint: The token is no longer readable from JavaScript. Takes effect at the next sign-in.
sec.noPasswordHintDev: The sign-in button is highlighted and opens an owner session (empty or admin, any password). Ignored outside npm run dev.
sec.noPasswordHintProd: Available only in development mode (npm run dev).
sec.proxyAuthOn: Trust the identity header from the reverse proxy
sec.proxyAuthHint: Silently signs users in from the identity header. Requires PORTAL_TRUST_PROXY=1 and the portal reachable only through the proxy. Roles come from the directory groups.

debug.intro: Checks computed on this instance. Nothing is sent outside.
debug.devDetail: Started via npm (NODE_ENV ≠ production) — Do not expose as-is
debug.weakDetail: Change it in Access (12 characters min.).
debug.noPwDetail: Anyone can open an admin session from the sign-in screen.
debug.oidcOriginDetail: Behind a reverse proxy, the callback can be wrong. Set the public URL.
debug.proxyDetail: PORTAL_TRUST_PROXY is not on: X-Forwarded-* is ignored.
debug.autoCreateDetail: Any unknown IdP user becomes a viewer.
debug.ldapTlsDetail: Binds travel in clear text. Prefer LDAPS (port 636).
debug.ldapAutoDetail: Any unknown directory user becomes a viewer.
debug.tokenDetail: An XSS can read the session. Turn on the HttpOnly cookie in Security if needed.
debug.cookieDetail: The token is no longer stored in sessionStorage.
debug.tlsDetail: Self-signed certificates pass. Normal on an internal network.
debug.publicDetail: A visitor can trigger a check on a visible card.

access.title: Access
access.usersLead: People, roles, groups and exceptions. Permissions add up: the most specific wins.
access.groupsLead: A group holds roles. Members inherit them.
access.rolesLead: A role is a set of permissions. Assign it to people or groups.
access.roleLocked: Owner account. Full access, not editable.
access.roleDrivesPerms: Rights come from the “{name}” role. Change them under Roles.
access.sourceAdHint: Directory group. Assign a Dockit role. Members come from AD at sign-in.
access.authLead: Identity sources for sign-in. Local login remains available.
access.ldapLead: One or more Active Directory domains. Local login remains available.
access.oidcLead: OpenID Connect (Keycloak, Authentik…). Local login remains available.
access.entraLead: Microsoft Entra ID will land later.
access.loginListHint: Drag to reorder, like extra links. The first row is shown first and pre-selected.
access.catsHint: A restricted category is visible only if the space is too.
access.entraSoon: Entra ID will land later. Use OpenID Connect for now.
access.systemHint: Built-in role. Name and permissions cannot be changed.
access.adminAccountHint: Built-in local account. Full access. Only the password can be changed.
access.roleDescOwner: Full access to the instance. Not editable.
access.roleDescAdmin: Manages access, settings, audit and restore. Sees every space; does not edit catalog content by default.
access.roleDescEditor: Edits categories and cards in public spaces.
access.deleteRoleBody: Assigned to {users} and {groups}. Those assignments will be removed.
access.deleteUserBody: The account and its assignments will be removed.
access.deleteGroupBody: {members} affected. Group roles will no longer apply.
access.directHint: Exception for this person, without creating a role.
access.permHint: Direct: exceptions on this record. Inherited: roles and groups. Effective: what actually applies — the most specific wins.
access.paneDirectHint: Exceptions on this record, on top of roles.
access.paneInheritedHint: From assigned roles and groups. Read-only.
access.paneEffectiveHint: What actually applies. Click a permission to see where it comes from.
access.restrictedHint: Without a grant, this space is hidden. Give access under Roles.
access.searchPerms: Search a space, card or action…
access.whyClick: Click a permission to see where it comes from.
access.movePickLead: Choose the destination space. Direct permissions stay on the category. Inheritance is recalculated.
access.discardBody: Unsaved edits on this row will be lost.
access.pickerDirOff: Directory search is not connected yet. Configure the provider under Identity Provider.
access.pickerDirType: Type at least 2 characters of the group CN.

users.unlockedPublic: Unlocked spaces are visible to everyone.
users.frameLead: Local accounts, roles, and space and category permissions.
users.adminHint: {name} — Full access. Only the password can be changed.

icons.faviconHint: Local copy from the link. Internal sites often have no public favicon.
icons.offlineHint: Online search is off (enable Iconify in Settings → Presentation for Internet access).
icons.replaceConfirm: Replace the current icon with the site favicon?

tags.prune: Delete a tag as soon as no card uses it
tags.pruneHint: Otherwise they stay in memory, even after the last card is destroyed.
tags.alphaHint: Applies to the tag list, search filters and chips on cards.

notFound.lead: This address does not match any space or card of the portal.
